Product Features

  • With the total dimensions of 140 x 40 x 70 cm, it is the ideal choice for a living room corner. The modular design with two horizontal and three vertical levels keeps things tidy without taking up too much space.
  • Stylish Design: The high-gloss front is simple and elegant, and the combination of white and black creates a fresh and classy look that adds a touch of modern flair to any living room and blends easily into any home décor.
  • Versatile storage options: Three cabinets offer space for large items, adjustable dividers allow for a variety of storage options, and the upper level offers a large, flat surface for frequently used items – perfect for all storage situations.
  • Smart LED Atmosphere: The LED light strips can be controlled via a mobile app and provide an immersive experience when watching movies with adjustable color and brightness, or brighten up your living room with warm warmth in everyday life.
  • High-gloss surface: Beautiful and easy to clean. Keeps your living room neat and clean, adding a touch of style and modernity to your lifestyle.
  • Practical Structure: The cabinet door has two storage compartments, one upper and one lower, with adjustable dividers. This results in five storage levels, which allow for a clear division of the items and special storage for each type.
  • Minimalist style: The white and black door panels in colour block design create a simple and elegant colour combination that matches various interior styles, including modern and Nordic, offering both aesthetics and functionality.
  • Load capacity and quality: The recommended load capacity is 40 kg. Soft-close hinges ensure smooth opening and closing, durability and a safe, durable and resilient door.
  • Functional integration: integration of storage, presentation and atmosphere creation, from practical storage to aesthetic presentation and smart lighting, using design to improve the quality of life in the living room.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!

Descriptions

Descriptions

This 140 x 40 x 70 cm sideboard perfectly combines functionality and style and offers more storage space in your living room. The versatile sideboard in a white and black color block design features three doors and adjustable dividers. This unique sideboard combines functionality and elegance, underlines your individual taste and gives your living space a breath of fresh air! Key features Stylish design: The white and black color block design is a real eye-catcher. Versatile storage space: The three doors offer plenty of storage space. Adjustable dividers: The partitions on the doors can be adjusted in five different positions, depending on your needs. Highlight and LED: The highlight position is limited to the front, without skirting boards, with LED light
